reasons: The cited Section 19 supports the compliant classification: 19.1 gives a professional/workmanlike and material-conformance warranty, 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformance warranty (and hosted Services conformance for the whole subscription term), 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance, and 19.4 provides re-performance/repair/replace with a fee refund on failure.

The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit the express warranties or remedies, so it does not swallow the express warranty — no walk-away 'AS IS' risk.

The failed deterministic period check is a false negative caused by the period being written in words ('ninety days') rather than digits; the substantive 90-day/term-long duration meets the preferred benchmark for a hosted model.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and none is needed; retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
